review.note: M55: written to carry the last of CShapes’ entity 255, which held three polities under one label. Its dates are Wikidata’s Q7318: P571 1933-03-15 and P576 1945-05-23. This is the record World War II and the Holocaust now name, in place of the chip reading "Germany (Prussia)" that the owner objected to on 17 September. Four years stand between its dissolution and the Federal Republic’s cited inception; the succession says so in its own note.

summary: A polity whose inception Wikidata states as 1933-03-15 on Q7318 and whose dissolution it states as 1945-05-23. Both years here are those two values. Its name is its own and not CShapes’ label for entity 255, "Germany (Prussia)", which covers this state, the Weimar Republic and the German Empire at once; its territory is that entity’s last two periods, the first of them cut at this record’s own cited inception. It is what the atlas’s World War II, the Holocaust, the Eastern Front, the Munich Agreement, the Molotov–Ribbentrop Pact, the Warsaw Uprising and the Spanish Civil War name for the German belligerent, occupier, signatory, supporter and perpetrator of those years.
